verdicts.reason: A keeps the copy in one cluster, but the alignments clash: the headline and teal line are left-aligned while the body copy is centered and shifted right. One divider floats to the right of the teal line and the other sits beside the contact text, the contact text is too small to read, and the top third is dead space. B scatters everything: the headline is jammed against the left edge, the body copy sits alone on the right, a divider floats at mid-left, the teal line breaks into two lines beside broken dash pieces, and the contact text is unreadably small at the far right edge, so there is no reading order or grouping.
